title: VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search

translated_title: VH-GPO：面向大语言模型智能体强化学习的经验证交接方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14000v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：诸如 GRPO 之类的组相对强化学习方法通过比较同一任务的多次轨迹采样来训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体。然而，当一个组内所有轨迹都以相同奖励失败时，相对优势会塌缩趋近于零，导致没有任何有用的学习信号。冻结的教师模型可以从学生曾访问过的状态中恢复，但如果让教师直接完成任务，恢复出的轨迹后缀将完全由教师生成。我们由此提出一个问题：在修复学生的失败之后，何时应将控制权交还给学生？我们提出了经结果验证的教师-学生交接方法，并将其实现为经验证交接的组策略优化（VH-GPO）。教师仅提供足够的支持，使学生到达一个其能够自主成功的状态，随后即交还控制权，从而让成功经验再次由学生自己生成。在给定经环境验证的教师恢复的前提下，VH-GPO 会在有界搜索范围内选择最早的、经独立确认的交接点。
tldr: VH-GPO 提出一种结果验证的教师-学生交接机制，教师只需将失败的智能体引导至其能自主成功的状态便交还控制权，从而在组相对强化学习中即使所有轨迹都失败时也能生成由学生自身产生的有效学习信号。
en_tdlr: VH-GPO introduces an outcome-verified teacher-student handoff mechanism in which the teacher only guides the failing agent to a state from which it can succeed before returning control, yielding student-generated successful learning signals even when all trajectories in group-relative reinforcement learning fail.
